title: H-MERGERSTOCK-2: the host's per-player access sets rebuild on ANY input change (AccessSets backstop), and a merged partner's till deposit routes to the owner even when the helper push is missing (HelperAt's merger-flip fallback). Leg 1: the HOST rents an EMPTY retail unit and stamps its business type AFTERWARDS - nothing but the backstop refreshes on that - and the client's helper set must grow within seconds. Leg 2: in the host's own clothing store the client's pushed helper entry is DROPPED (the missed push, synthesized) and a native hand deposit into the till must still route to the owner, who applies it. Leg 3: a partner's flipped HOME (a flat the host rents) never reads helper=True. NO save.
preconditions: Reporter fixture fx-hq1 (MERGED pair melaus + Client1; vars.keepMerger true so tools/regress.py resets it with --keep-merger). Host melaus owns the clothing store in vars.ownerShop; the fixture loads Client1 inside a building, so both exit first. Dev build with the H-MERGERSTOCK-2 levers: `forrent <buildingtype>` filter, `helperstate [addr [drop]]`, `deposit <addr> [amount|probe]`, plus rent / settype / itemcount / stockof / enterbuilding / exitbuilding / mergestatus. WHY THE DEPOSIT IS NOT IN THE RENTED UNIT: a freshly rented building holds only its delivery spot and hand-truck spawner (the `rent` lever reports exactly those) - there is no till or shelf to deposit into, and no lever can furnish one. So leg 1 proves the REBUILD on the exact field premise (empty rental, type set later) and leg 2 proves the DEPOSIT on the fallback bundle 145749 needed, in a shop that has stations. Run 2 (2026-09-24) found EVERY station in the fixture store full (tills 1000/1000 paper bags, racks 50/50), so the OWNER first frees 50 on one till (`stationroom`, in memory) and the client's `deposit probe` names the station/item before the owner's stock of that item is read. fx-hq1 has NO partner home flipped on the client (run 1: homes=0), so leg 3 rents a flat on the host (type empty) to give the negative a real partner residence. NOTHING is saved. ORACLE NOTE (run 3, 2026-09-24): after the owner confirms the routed put, the client mirrors it onto its own replica through StorageSync.EchoBuildingReplica -> PutIntoSingleSlot -> ItemInstance.MergeCargo, and DepositGuard logs that echo as UNROUTED (helper=True, the echo cargo is not the hands) although it is the mod's own confirmed replica write. The absent-oracle lets ONLY that echo path through; it stays visible as a report oracle.
